reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent source-semantic review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP and Radare2 6.2.0 on retail igi.exe; candidate translation unit recompiled with the repository -O3 flags.
review_basis: The current engine/src/retail/error/error_show.cpp hashes to e159b0edbadbe67f217119e07165c40c66245821b552b9864a987759026a3b9e. The retail entry was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view and independently recovered with Radare2; both graphs are recorded in the referenced evidence files and agree at 1.000 on nodes and edges. The candidate source and its compiled object symbol were then read against that reconstruction. This review supersedes the earlier evidence that was stale against the current source digest.

retail_function.name: sprintf
retail_function.summary: 0x004A53B3-0x004A5405 (82 bytes), 4 blocks/4 edges; initializes a stack _iobuf over the destination with count 0x7FFFFFFF and flags 0x42, calls the formatting engine at 0x004A7720 with the variadic list, writes the NUL terminator and returns the formatted length.

candidate_function.summary: igi::retail::error::sprintf(char*, const char*, ...): forwards to String_VFormat, which calls the host std::vsprintf and NUL-terminates buffer[result]. The retail _iobuf/_output instruction sequence is not reproduced; formatting is delegated to the host CRT.

checks.name: function_boundary
checks.detail: Binary Ninja and Radare2 recover 82 bytes, 4 blocks/4 edges; cfg_similarity 1.0.

checks.name: abi
checks.detail: Both are cdecl variadic char*(char*,const char*,...); the candidate va_list paves the same 32-bit stack arguments.

checks.name: host_crt
checks.detail: The candidate does not reproduce the retail _iobuf setup or call 0x004A7720; it delegates to std::vsprintf. Bounded integer/string cases agree, but %n, floating-point, 64-bit and overflow behavior depend on the host CRT and are outside the reviewed equivalence.

checks.name: behavioural_differential
checks.detail: scripts/format_diff_runner.py executed retail in VEX and modeled the candidate CRT with bounded integer/string fixtures; 10/10 returned the same length and 512-byte destination.

signature_comparison.rationale: Retail is variadic cdecl (char*, char*, ...); the candidate is variadic cdecl (char*, const char*, ...). The va_list stack layout is preserved.

behavioural.method: Retail formatter instructions executed in VEX; candidate PE32 CRT boundary modeled by host libc snprintf with explicit x86 va_list dword reads for bounded integer/string formats. Exact return and 512 destination bytes compared.

limitations: The port delegates to host vsprintf rather than transcribing the retail _iobuf/_output path, so host-CRT differences remain.
The differential covers bounded integer/string C-locale formats only; no floating point, overflow, invalid pointers or CRT failures.
No live paired runtime capture exists.
The behavioural differential is emulator/host execution (VEX, Unicorn or angr plus the compiled candidate), not a live paired retail/candidate game process.
The CFG agreement cited here is Binary Ninja vs Radare2 on the retail image; angr CFGFast was not rerun for this rebind.
cfg_similarity 1.0 is not a candidate-vs-retail CFG score; the candidate machine CFG was not compared for isomorphism.
